summary: Added `publishTaskStateSync` to `src/marmot/device-sync.ts` and wired it as a fire-and-forget call in `GroupManager.tsx:handleInvite` after `inviteByKeyPackageEvent` succeeds. Five unit tests added to `device-sync.test.ts` covering the error-swallow contract, nip44 guard, deleted-task exclusion, and d-tag format.

mocks_introduced.reason: loadEvents hits real IndexedDB which is unavailable in vitest node environment
replayEvents needs to be controlled per-test to simulate task state with/without deleted tasks

implementation_notes: The reducer's task.deleted handling removes tasks from the Map entirely, so Array.from(taskState.values()) already gives only non-deleted tasks — no explicit filter needed.

GroupManager.tsx guards the call with `if (signer)` because useMarmot() returns `signer: null` during the loading state, and a null signer would cause a TypeError before publishTaskStateSync's internal guard could run.
The two new vi.mock entries were placed at the top of device-sync.test.ts before imports; Vitest hoists them correctly and all pre-existing tests still pass.
